work.title: The primitive balanced-degree spectrum in the two-pair Image problem
work.abstract: Over every characteristic-zero field, the balanced degrees admitting radially primitive, absolutely nonpower two-pair Image counterexamples are precisely $4,6,7,8,\ldots$. All pure balanced phases through degree three are safe, as are all pure radially primitive balanced quintics. One explicit integer family realizes the failure degrees with a common marker of balanced degree one that detects every positive power. We also prove that an abelian variety with Rosati-compatible rank-two multiplication by a CM field has ordinary primes of density one after finite extension if at most two conjugate embedding pairs have Hodge multiplicities $(1,1)$. The full geometric endomorphism algebra may be larger than the acting field. In the quintic proof, this theorem supplies ordinary reduction for factors of cyclic covers whose Frobenius coefficients detect nonzero polynomial moments.
work.subject: math.AC
work.comments: Complete classification of the primitive balanced degree spectrum for the two-pair Image problem, together with a density-one ordinary reduction theorem for abelian varieties with rank-two CM-field multiplication. Part of the ongoing Jacobian research project. Proof development and manuscript preparation were AI-assisted. Research materials are available at https://github.com/royvanrijn/jacobian-research. Independent verification is welcome.
